name: node-red-alephscript-sdk
description: SDK monorepo: Node-RED contrib nodes and a web UI (GamificationUI) for AlephScript

scripts.build:all: npm run build:contrib && npm run build:ui
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contrib && npm run test:ui
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:contrib && npm run lint:ui
scripts.lint:fix:all: npm run lint:fix:contrib && npm run lint:fix:ui
scripts.install:all: cd packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript && npm install && cd ../node-red-gamify-ui && npm install
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:contrib && npm run clean:ui
